stats.title: People trust us with their homes
stats.desc: Gyacity is a team of highly qualified architects and interior designers with seven years of practice. We understand that every space is unique — just like the people who live in it. That's why your vision, lifestyle and personal style are always at the heart of our work.
stats.stat1: Completed projects — from private apartments to commercial spaces across different countries.
stats.stat2: Skilled professionals in our team, each bringing expertise in design, architecture and visualisation.
stats.stat3: Countries our clients come from — we confidently work on international projects.

clients.title: What our clients say
testimonials: Gyacity turned our living room into something we never imagined possible. Every detail was thought through — from the ceiling to the finishes. Our family can't stop talking about it.
We trusted Sydney and his team with our home in Kumasi, and they delivered beyond anything we expected. The space feels warm, considered, and unmistakably ours.
What impressed me most was how they listened. They didn't just design for the space — they designed for our family. I recommend Gyacity to everyone I know in Kumasi.
From the first meeting to the final handover, everything was handled with real professionalism and care. They understood exactly what we wanted, even before we did.

belief.text: Creating with you, not for you. Every space is a reflection of shared vision and open dialogue — bringing depth, harmony and character to the final design.

vision.desc: Our experts will be happy to help you create a harmonious space that suits your needs and style.

about.belief_text: Creating with you, not for you. Every space is a reflection of shared vision and open dialogue — bringing depth, harmony and character to the final design.

beliefs.label: Restraint
beliefs.text: We work with subtraction. Fewer materials, deeper consideration of each. The best detail is often the one you don't notice.

beliefs.label: Place
beliefs.text: Architecture belongs to a climate, a culture, a particular fall of light. We design with site — not despite it.

beliefs.label: Craft
beliefs.text: Our in-house atelier holds the line from sketch to install. Furniture, doors, joinery — made within the practice.

beliefs.label: Patience
beliefs.text: We accept a limited number of commissions each season. The work takes the time it takes.

stats: Architects, designers and makers across three studios.
Years in practice. Same principles, refined each year.

milestones.d: Sydney Gyasi Nimako opens Gyacity as a single-room atelier in Kumasi.
The first private homes are delivered across Kumasi and Accra.
The practice brings furniture, joinery and finishes under one roof.
The Bar and Emerald Lounge open in Accra — hospitality and residential in one year.
Gyacity expands into Europe with a second studio in Berlin.

services_home.title: What we do.
services_home.sub: Seven disciplines. One studio. Architecture, interiors and construction, delivered under one roof.

services_page.title: Services.
services_page.tagline: Architecture, interiors and construction — from first sketch to final handover.

services.name: Interior Design
services.desc: Spatial planning, material selection, furniture, lighting and styling — considered from concept to completion.

services.name: Architecture
services.desc: New builds, extensions and architectural renovations. From planning application to structural design, we shape the form and flow of your space.

services.name: Build & Construction
services.desc: We manage the full construction ourselves. No third-party delays, no handover gaps. Your architect and builder answer to the same studio.

services.name: Lighting Design
services.desc: Ambient, accent and task lighting designed for atmosphere. Cove, pendant, strip and spot — positioned and specified to the millimetre.

services.name: FF&E
services.desc: Furniture, fixtures and equipment selected for your space, your lifestyle and your budget. Every piece considered before it crosses the threshold.

services.name: Custom Joinery
services.desc: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes, cabinetry and built-ins designed and made in-house. Made to measure, made to last.

services.name: Landscaping
services.desc: Exterior environments designed as carefully as the interiors — planting, hardscaping, pool surrounds, terraces and outdoor lighting, shaped to extend the architecture into the landscape.

steps.d: A detailed consultation to understand your vision, timeline and budget.
Concept development, spatial planning, material boards and 3D visualisations.
Our in-house team manages the full construction — coordinated, on time, on budget.
Final snag, final clean, final walk-through. We don't leave until it's right.
